length.sourceNote: European specification. US-market cars were 4923 mm over larger impact bumpers — recorded as a market variant rather than overwriting this figure.

power.sourceNote: Output varied by market and model year across the M90/M30B34/M30B35 engines. Not yet sourced per variant — a single figure here would be a guess, so the field stays empty (SPEC.md §2.3).

mass.sourceNote: The generation spans 1450–1619 kg across all trims and markets; the figure for this specific trim has not been sourced. A range cannot be stored in a single PropertyValue.

frontalArea.sourceNote: Estimated as 0.85 × width × height = 0.85 × 1.725 m × 1.365 m ≈ 2.00 m², the standing approximation documented in SPEC.md §8.2. Not a measured figure.
